member.name: T:SQL2CS.Modernized.Controllers.ChamadosController
member.summary: REST endpoints for the Chamado resource.
member.remarks:
Replaces the following legacy ASP pages:
chamados.asp (crud_form)
excluir_chamado.asp (action_handler)
pesquisa_chamados.asp (list_search)
The legacy pages opened an ADODB.Connection directly and built SQL by string concatenation. Data access now goes through IChamadoService, which uses parameterised EF Core queries.

member.name: T:SQL2CS.Modernized.Exceptions.DomainException
member.summary: Raised when a business rule rejects an operation.
member.remarks:
The legacy PL/pgSQL routines enforced their rules with RAISE EXCEPTION, which surfaced to the ASP page as an ADO error and was rendered in a banner. This exception carries the same messages, and the controllers translate it into a 400 response so the Angular form can display it.
Rules preserved from the legacy schema:
Chamado nao encontrado.
A solucao tecnica deve ser preenchida para resolver ou fechar o chamado.
